column1: WAGES  BOARD  FOR  THE  RUBBER  GROWING  AND  RAW  RUBBER  PROCESSING  TRADE
IT is hereby notified, under regulation 30 of the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136) that, in terms of section 9 of the said
Ordinance, the Hon. Minister of Labour has appointed Mr. A.A.A.S. Rajarathna, Mr. M.A.B.V.U. Kumara Bandaranayaka
and Mr. G.A. Piyal Pathmanatha as Nominated members of the Wages Board for the Rubber Growing and Raw Rubber
Processing Trade in place of Mrs. Joseph Devamargaret, Mr. Malaka Weerasinghe Arachchige and Mr. Kapila Priyantha
Senevirathna respectively, and Mr. Nissanka Bandara Senevirathna and Mr. D.B.S.L. Perera have been appointed as Employer
representatives in place of Mr. B. Bulumulla and Mr. Pradeep Hemantha Bandara Liyanagedara respectively for the said
wages board. This appointment is valid only up to 31.12.2026.
